title: Steelers reward TE Darnell Washington with massive four-year, $42 million extension

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Steelers reward TE Darnell Washington with massive four-year, $42 million extension
sources.description: After setting career highs in catches and receiving yards in 2025, Darnell Washington has earned a four-year, $42 million extension from the Steelers that includes $21 million guaranteed
